title: Structural Engineer (SE or PE)
job_description:
Right Angle Engineering provides structural design services nationwide. We're looking for a licensed, motivated engineer who's ready to grow with a fast-moving team across a broad range of structural projects.

Responsibilities

Review and update load calculations; provide structural assessments for failing structures
Perform engineering calculations and red-line drawings for deep foundations, retaining walls, residential construction, and more
Work toward managing projects from start to finish
Obtain licensure in states of work as needed
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Active PE license required (structural focus preferred)
Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering required
Experience with deep foundations, retaining walls, and residential or light commercial structures
Proficient in RISA 3D, AutoCAD, and Excel
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Must be authorized to work in the United States

Graduates in related engineering disciplines (mechanical, etc.) may be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Compensation & Benefits

Medical and dental insurance
Paid time off and holidays
Opportunity to grow within a supportive, expanding team

Schedule: Full-time | 8-hour shifts

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $80,000.00 - $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Paid time off
Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

Please list your active license number for one state you're currently licensed in.

License/Certification:

Professional Engineering License (Required)

Work Location: Remote
